caption: The drawing features a single, detailed teapot rendered in pencil on an off-white background. The teapot has a rounded body with a wide spout on the left and a large handle on the right. The lid, positioned on top, has a small decorative knob. Engraved on the central body of the teapot are the words: "'Warrie' from his Grandfather Dec 25 1856" written in a cursive script. The teapot shows reflective shading to give an impression of its metallic surface and three-dimensional form. At the bottom right, there is a smaller, simplified sketch of the teapot included inside a faint square. The composition is centralized, with the full teapot dominating the majority of the drawing while the inset sketch and the handwritten signature "Irene Magaziner" appear in the lower right corner. The image is monochromatic, utilizing various shades of gray created with pencil.
title: Silver Tankard
